data.name: Longevity: Path of the Immortal
data.detailed_description:
A Cultivation Epic Woven by Karma: Your Choices Define the Heavenly Dao

The world shifts around you. From Lingxi Village to Tiandu City, every decision you make — saving a soul, claiming a treasure, wiping out a sect — sends ripples like a butterfly's wings, unleashing unforeseen chain reactions hours or even days later. The shadow of the Demonic Path permeates every storyline, and you are the one who will tear through this dark web.

From Bitter Rivals to Dao Companions: A Deep Romance & Bond System

Every immortal maiden, demonic sorceress, and sect saintess you meet is far more than a conquest. Each stands by her own convictions and harbors her own agendas. Subdue them by force, win their hearts to become Dao companions, or help them seize power to forge political alliances. Every relationship is a unique journey of power, trust, and desire.

A Sect Legacy Worth Inheriting: Blessed Caves, Dao Lineages, and Bloodlines

Forge your own cave abode and build your inherited sanctuary together with your Dao companion. Cultivate spirit plants, lay down grand formations — your interactions unlock exclusive events and inherited cultivation arts. When your bond deepens enough to seal a marriage pact, your offspring will inherit unique spiritual roots and talents, allowing your sect and bloodline to truly endure across generations.

Spirit General Possession × Formation Synergy: Immortal Combat Built on Strategy

Combat is never a raw numbers game. Summon the spirits of legendary generals or ancient ferocious beasts to possess your form and shift your battle style on the fly. Deploy formation flags with tactical cunning, turning the environment to your advantage — freeze lakes with ice formations to trap foes, or let the wind fan your fire formations into a raging inferno. Every victory is the perfect fusion of strategy and cultivation.

Boundless Aerial Exploration: An Immersive 3D Xianxia Open World

Take flight on your sword and soar seamlessly across a vast immortal realm — from Lingxi Village and the Frostpeak Pavilion to the grand capital of Tiandu. There are no invisible walls here, only hidden cave abodes, lost ruins, and spontaneous wonders waiting to be discovered. The entire world is yours to roam, without limits.

A Living Realm Shared by Thousands: Every Ally, Every Rival — A Real Player

Leave the solitary path behind. This is a living world shaped entirely by real cultivators like you.

Team up with friends to raid ancient secret realms, where every role matters and coordination is everything. Found or join a sect to battle guilds worldwide for spirit vein resources, navigating the intrigue of negotiation, alliance, and all-out war. Every trade you make, every shift in your reputation — all flow through a truly dynamic economy and social system.

Tribulation, Ascension, and the Road to Immortality: Realm Breakthroughs & Endless Growth

Walk the full path of cultivation — from Qi Refining through Heavenly Tribulation, all the way to ascension beyond the mortal realm. Every breakthrough is a brutal test of both your resolve and your power. The game offers boundless growth paths: master alchemy and artifact forging, build a merchant empire, dedicate yourself to the sword, or delve deep into arcane spells — every road can lead to your own version of eternal immortality.

data.short_description: Longevity: Path of the Immortal — 3D xianxia RPG. Cast from your sect by conspiracy, you defy destiny. Every choice ripples through karma — shifting factions, altering fates, reshaping realms. Battle the Demonic Path, unearth ancient legacies, and carve your own road to immortality.
